test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Ranthambore : Rajasthan :: Kaziranga : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• Ranthambore national park is situated in Rajasthan.
 
• Similarly, Kaziranga national park is situated in Assam.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
